entities.summary: Thomas Cromwell, 1st Earl of Essex, served as Henry VIII's chief minister from 1532 to 1540. He was the principal architect of the English Reformation, engineering the Break with Rome, the Dissolution of the Monasteries, and the administrative revolution that centralized English government.
